title: Shop
description: A static shop definition (*.shop.json): a fixed list of items at fixed prices.

id.description: Stable identifier for this shop, with a required namespace (for example base:market_seeds).

name.description: Display name shown on the shop screen and in the editor.

buysGoods.description: Whether the shop buys the player's goods, at each item's sell price.

offerings.description: Items the shop sells, in display order. Each is always in stock.

itemId.description: ID of the item sold. It must exist in the game's items.

folderPath.description: Virtual folder path for workspace organization. Empty string or absent = root.
